name: BL-176 criteria: a fresh three-stage Broad search on the F6-fixed (point-in-time) ranking
source: backlog/BL-176-momentum-search-on-f6-ranking.md, Phase 0; this file is the machine-readable copy of its rules
rule: Committed before any BL-176 run beyond a one-group smoke. Never edited after results are seen: a change is a new file that names this one as superseded, with the reason. Any departure is an `override: <reason>` line in the item.
reason: BL-001's F6 fix (merged 2026-10-28, 778ba02e) changed the Broad ranking every BL-010 figure and the favourites' selection were made on. Owner, 2026-10-30: start from scratch (a fresh search and a fresh selection, not a measurement of the F6 effect), and do it more elaborately (every searchable axis).
applies_unchanged: bl010_criteria.json: baskets, minimum bar (+5 points over Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI after tax), comparators
bl010_criteria_addendum_3.json: the Phase 5 choice rule (rank measure, clusters at 0.9, medoid, 8-12 holdings preference, walk-forward kill)
bl010_criteria_addendum_4.json: the ensemble rule if the single pick is killed
bl010_criteria_addendum_6.json and _8.json: gates G1-G6 for the followed strategy

owner_decisions_2026_10_30.arms: A, C1 and B; C2 stays unrun
owner_decisions_2026_10_30.tag_sets: both, ranked separately: arm A runs every point under curated and under extended tags (paired: same seed, same points); B enters both rankings; C1 (extended only) enters the extended ranking only
owner_decisions_2026_10_30.return_basis: mixed: every ranking step pre-tax after costs; every gate after tax at Rs 50,000 a sleeve; no walking down to the next cluster when a pick fails the after-tax bar
owner_decisions_2026_10_30.still_holds: looser line for the followed strategy; favourites keep the top-decile line
owner_decisions_2026_10_30.run_slot: Stage 1 from Saturday 2026-10-31, paused before Monday 07:30 if unfinished
owner_decisions_2026_10_30.stage_1_space: confirmed as written, including capital Rs 50,000 and the Rs 5,000 price ceiling

stage_1.rank_measure_recorded_per_run: search.rank_measures: FY excess over Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI per complete financial year, its 25th percentile (lb_fy_excess), and the drawdown baskets every fall passes; pre-tax, the run's own sampled Friday

expected_directions.voladj_lookbacks: true loses (BL-086); its best cells on [13,26,52] and [26,52]
expected_directions.fill: mon_open more return and a deeper worst fall than next_fri_close (BL-158); mon_close between
expected_directions.top_sector_weight: 2 helps (BL-116 development); the 2023-26 half is its confirmation and BL-116 Phase 2 closes on it
expected_directions.tags: extended 4-11 CAGR points lower and 7-14 points deeper worst fall than curated at the same settings (BL-010 Log 2026-10-10)

stage_1.tilt_rule: the stock tilt needs a long lookback (26 or 52) and a short one; for [26, 52] and [1, 4, 13] the sampled stock_tilt and stock_tilt_screen_pct are set to 0 before the run id is made (search.without_impossible_tilt), so those groups run untilted and say so

stage_2.how: scripts/bl176_focus.py, committed before Stage 1 runs; per arm and tag set
stage_2.qualify: per basket, the top 5% (rounded up) of the Stage 1 runs passing it, by lb_fy_excess; a basket qualifies with at least 20; the qualifying baskets' runs are pooled; no qualifying basket = no Stage 2 for that arm
stage_2.numeric_axis: pool's 10th to 90th percentile, clipped to Stage 1's range (ints widened to whole numbers); band axes read as exit minus top; rebalance_offset_raw keeps Stage 1's range
stage_2.choice_axis: values held by at least 10% of the pool, light and heavy; heavy combinations = product of those values, inert ones removed, all run

stage_3.blend: every config in the top decile of each basket (by lb_fy_excess) over Stages 1 and 2 pooled across the arms in a ranking is re-scored on all its offsets (`mbt search score --ids`) and judged as the all-Fridays blend; no single-offset figure reaches a ranking
stage_3.selection: the BL-010 machinery as written, once per tag ranking: baskets, addendum 3 rule, addendum 4 ensemble if killed, top 100 vs 100 random over FY windows, PBO on 16 blocks (kill above 0.3), fair placebo (100 seeds), nudge plateau, factor alpha; one pick, ensemble or none per basket per tag ranking, frozen with commit and data snapshot
stage_3.locate: the followed strategy, Five Sectors Rank Sum and the ten favourites: blend percentile in the space, basket, gates G1-G6
stage_3.followed_still_holds: top half of the space by the pre-tax rank measure, AND +5 points over Nifty200 Momentum 30 TRI after tax (G1), AND worst fall inside -40%; read in both tag rankings; holding on curated but not extended is reported as 'holds only on hindsight tags'
stage_3.favourite_keeps_place: its blend in the top decile of the space by the rank measure
stage_3.lookahead: mbt audit lookahead-requests on the finalists at 2019-06-28, 2021-06-25, 2024-03-28 must be identical before the verdict
stage_3.footnote: round 7's 2026-10-08 top 10 placed in the new ranking, written after the pick is frozen

trial_count: counted per ranking from the results files (curated about 30,000 in Stage 1, extended about 34,000, plus each one's Stage 2; the paired A runs count in both), plus round 7's 8,003 (and 4,754 on C1/C2) named as prior trials
hold_out: none unseen; 2012-2016 spent by BL-010 Phase 6; the forward journal (BL-024) is the only out-of-sample from here on
will_not_run: a value outside the listed choices
a Stage 2 range chosen by hand, or a third search stage
levers killed after tax on Broad: cadence slower than 4 weeks, stops, inverse-vol sizing, residual momentum, the ETF blend, momentum sizing, mass-exit rules, feature tilts, chart patterns
